summary: This conversation explored the intersection of your mental state, evolutionary psychology, and your practical goals.

keyPoints.title: The Aesthetic of Dissociation
keyPoints.description: Painting with hate or consuming toxic imagery provides a dark comfort, externalizing self-loathing to create a buffer zone from heavy reality.

keyPoints.title: The Evolutionary Freeze
keyPoints.description: Feeling worthless or unavailable is a misfired survival mechanism—using dissociation to numb modern responsibility and self-belittlement to avoid external judgment.

keyPoints.title: Self-Neutrality over Self-Love
keyPoints.description: Functional existence treats the self as a mechanical system performing tasks regardless of self-liking or software crashes.

keyPoints.title: Defining Priorities
keyPoints.description: Top Priorities: Securing a job, continuing studies, and managing business. Hobbies/Tools: Android projects and Gemini experiments are secondary to reduce pressure.

nextStep: Pick one small, 5-minute task for job hunting or studying to approach with functional neutrality.
